name: Mighty Switch Force!
description:
Meet Patricia Wagon, cybernetic
police officer on a mission to put the
Hooligan Sisters back behind bars. By
activating her Siren Helmet, Patricia
can shift the machine matrix of Planet
Land, altering the world around her.
Use your wits and trusty Pellet Gun to
blow crime away!

Update includes: 
- 5 bonus levels
- enhanced 3D graphics
- quick-retry feature
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
